name: jazzy-runtime-versions
argv: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /work/install/setup.bash; python3 -c "import cv2,numpy,sys; from importlib.metadata import version; print(sys.version); print(\"rclpy\",version(\"rclpy\")); print(\"OpenCV\",cv2.__version__); print(\"NumPy\",numpy.__version__)"; dpkg-query -W ros-jazzy-rclpy python3-opencv python3-numpy; grep -A3 -m1 "License:" /usr/share/doc/python3-opencv/copyright; grep -A3 -m1 "License:" /usr/share/doc/python3-numpy/copyright; grep license /opt/ros/jazzy/share/rclpy/package.xml
